newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco B jumps 6.34 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Meralco B jumps 6.34 pct in early trade.

text.p: Shares of Philippine power utility Meralco B surged 6.34 percent to 151 pesos in early trade on Monday apparently boosted by fallout from the peso depreciation, analysts said.
"People are saying that with the de facto devaluation, there might be an increase in the price of power rates," a senior market analyst told Reuters.
"This augurs well for Meralco because they will be able to pass on the burden to consumers."
"We cannot think of any other reason," the analyst said.
"This is a continuation of what happened last Friday," another analyst said. "We are seeing the effects of the devaluation reacting positively to quite a number of blue chips."
